[REFERENCE] 14. Reports constant alertness and being on the edge

[RESPONSE] I’ve been having really upsetting dreams and disturbing flashbacks, along with marked anxiety — all starting about 7 weeks ago. I’m constantly on edge, easily startled, especially by loud noises, which reminds me of what I experienced in Iraq. I’ve been avoiding places that bring back those memories, like the shooting range, and lately I’ve even been refusing to leave the house unless my wife persuades me. I also feel guilty about things that happened during my deployment, and I’ve had trouble sleeping. I took a leave from my job as an army instructor because it’s been so hard to cope — I just haven’t been able to adjust back to life at home since returning from active duty in Iraq three months ago.
